title: Sign-Up Bar Deck
status: published pagelocked; pinned closed on Max's Picks
requested: Machan, Nov 14 2026, 9:07 PM ICT, on the sign-up bottom bar: “Send a deck”. A short deck of layout options for the sign-up bar, with real phone mockups at 360, 390 and 430 wide of the How Big Is Your Home? step, including the house band. A is Develop’s current version: small Back, Home and Start Over tabs over a big Next. B is one row of Back, Start Over and Next, styled like the Home bar (cream #F5EDDF with a hairline and sheen), Next filled #C1502E and the others outlined, all the same height. C is one row of Back, Home and Next in the same style. D is a tighter one-row idea: Back as an icon button, a wide Next, and Start Over as a small text link above the bar. Phone-first, light cream, Khand and Hind, Title Case, no green header band, no gold.
provenance: Frames are a local render of smart-upkeep PR #140 at 9833cf4836fd37e881d84203020f0f76b1a65411, from a git archive unlocked only in a private mode-700 folder, served on 127.0.0.1 with outside traffic blocked and fonts served locally. Option A is that update as it is. Options B, C and D add CSS in the local session only; D also moves Start Over to a text link just above the cream bar in that session. The archive and the smart-upkeep repo were not edited, and nothing was pushed to smart-upkeep. Each option was captured at 360×640, 390×660 and 430×746 at 2×, full frame, no crop, then placed side by side on a cream board. Bar controls are 44px or larger, with label contrast of 4.5:1 or better, and no clipped or wrapped bar labels at 360. Air is the gap under the Stories card, down to the sticky bar (or to the Start Over link on D). A 36px leftover on the document scroll is present on the baseline too (page chrome, not the step). Nothing was submitted, paid or sent. Gold is not used.
